spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (मोटति) 6th cl. (मुटति); and 10th cl. (मोटयति); also (इ) मुटि r. 1st. cl. (मुण्टति^1)
1 To rub, to press, to grind or pound, to reduce to powder.
2 To break down, to trample on.
6th cl. (मुटति)
To reprove, to rebuke, to blame.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.
